tools.name: noxgild_devices
tools.description: List this account's authorized Noxgild computers and their authoritative online/worker health state.

tools.name: noxgild_capabilities
tools.description: List the curated Noxgild capabilities available for machine, browser, and Windows control.

tools.name: noxgild_execute
tools.description: Execute one curated Noxgild capability on an explicitly selected authorized computer and wait briefly for the authoritative outcome. Routine and reversible actions run autonomously; very destructive actions remain queued until explicitly approved. Never retry a command whose status is UNKNOWN withou

tools.name: noxgild_submit
tools.description: Submit one curated Noxgild capability without waiting for completion. Routine and reversible actions may execute asynchronously; very destructive actions remain queued until explicitly approved. Returns a durable command record.

tools.name: noxgild_approve
tools.description: Explicitly approve one queued very destructive or untrusted cross-layer command after reviewing its exact command ID, capability, and arguments. This authorization applies only to that command.

tools.name: noxgild_command
tools.description: Read the authoritative status/result of a Noxgild command.

tools.name: noxgild_wait
tools.description: Wait up to 25 seconds for an existing Noxgild command to complete, fail, cancel, or enter UNKNOWN.

tools.name: noxgild_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a Noxgild command when cancellation is still possible.

tools.name: noxgild_wake
tools.description: Wake an offline Noxgild computer using an online Noxgild helper on the same LAN. The target BIOS/NIC must support Wake-on-LAN.

tools.name: noxgild_cloud_browser_start
tools.description: Start an isolated Noxgild cloud browser session only when this task does not already have a known active cloud browser session. Reuse a known sessionId for follow-up actions. If the known session is human-controlled, ask the user to give control back instead of starting another session. Use the loca

tools.name: noxgild_cloud_browser_view
tools.description: Refresh the inline viewer state and a short-lived viewer connection for an existing cloud browser session.

tools.name: noxgild_cloud_browser_execute
tools.description: Run one existing curated browser capability in an agent-controlled Noxgild cloud browser session. Browser security challenges remain human gates and uncertain side effects are never blindly replayed.

tools.name: noxgild_cloud_browser_take_control
tools.description: Transfer this cloud browser from the agent to the human viewer. This tool is UI-only and cannot be initiated by the model.

tools.name: noxgild_cloud_browser_release_control
tools.description: Return a human-controlled cloud browser to Noxgild and refresh agent state before further automation. This tool is UI-only.

tools.name: noxgild_cloud_browser_close
tools.description: Close an isolated Noxgild cloud browser session and release its browser compute.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "noxgild_approve" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
